subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress failure fallback when source delivery is message-tool-only

question: Which open PR should be the canonical landing path for Telegram message-tool-only fallback suppression now that both candidate branches conflict with current main?
rationale: The bug is still present, but the remaining choice is maintainer ownership of the canonical branch, rebase shape, and proof bar rather than a new code discovery task.

options.title: Rebase the narrower proven guard
options.body: Use the sibling PR's narrower guard placement and stronger production-log proof as the canonical shape, rebasing or cherry-picking it onto current main before closing this duplicate.

options.title: Rebase this member PR
options.body: Keep this PR as canonical only if maintainers prefer the member-authored branch and update it against current Telegram dispatcher changes.

options.title: Land a fresh maintainer patch
options.body: Close or pause both conflicting branches after applying the one-line guard and regression directly on a fresh maintainer branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase the narrower proven guard
recommendation.body: Use the sibling PR's narrower guard placement and stronger production-log proof as the canonical shape, rebasing or cherry-picking it onto current main before closing this duplicate.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main predicate blame and broader Telegram/plugin-boundary history make steipete the best routing owner for choosing the canonical landing path.
